info.title: Tenant Cluster API
info.description: Tenant projection of workload clusters. The evaluation deployment is unauthenticated and serves one configured datastore namespace. Create accepts exactly one canonical IPv4 CIDR each for pods and services; the ranges must not overlap. Internal CRD descriptions may describe broader networking capabilities than this public version. See public/tenant/README.md for admission, lifecycle, and strict JSON rules.

tags.name: ClusterService
tags.description: ClusterService manages the supported tenant projection of workload clusters.

post.summary:
CreateCluster accepts one canonical IPv4 CIDR for pods and one for services.
The two ranges must not overlap; broader CRD networking shapes are not supported.

put.summary: ReplaceCluster replaces update-writable intent under a version precondition.

ClusterStatusReason.description:
Reason refines the lifecycle state without exposing private diagnostics.

 - REASON_AWAITING_OBSERVATION: No current controller observation is available yet.
 - REASON_RECONCILING: The controller is reconciling the current generation.
 - REASON_RECONCILED: The controller reports that the current generation is ready.
 - REASON_CREATE_REJECTED: The create request was rejected by the provisioning service.
 - REASON_UNSUPPORTED_CONFIGURATION: The configuration is not supported by the controller.
 - REASON_UNSUPPORTED_UPDATE: The requested update is not supported by the controller.
 - REASON_PROVISIONING_FAILED: Provisioning has failed.
 - REASON_DELETION_REQUESTED: Deletion has been requested.
 - REASON_CLEANUP_BLOCKED: Cleanup is blocked because the create outcome is not known.
 - REASON_OBSERVATION_UNAVAILABLE: Readiness cannot currently be observed due to an operational condition.

ClusterStatusState.description:
State describes the current public lifecycle observation.

 - STATE_PENDING: Waiting for the controller to observe or reconcile the current generation.
 - STATE_READY: The controller reports that the current generation is ready.
 - STATE_FAILED: A reviewed failure prevents the current generation from becoming ready.
 - STATE_DELETING: Deletion has been requested, including when cleanup is blocked.
 - STATE_UNKNOWN: The controller cannot currently determine the resource's readiness.

These fields are output only; create and replace requests cannot set status.
